text: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese nationality. 2. High school diploma (or equivalent to high school diploma) or above is required. 3. Chinese Language program: 18-25 years old(students under 18 are not acceptable). 4. Ability to learn languages and communicate in English is preferred. 5. Interests in Chinese Culture, society, and economy. 6. Self-discipline and interpersonal skills are required for independent living and studying; you must also be in good health. 7. Abide by the laws and regulations of China. 8. This program is available for beginner and intermdiate level.
